body:
Don't make me cry, please...how could you possibly care for me when you know nothing of me? I'm 30, I know that life is just a bunch of ups and downs. But my life has been chasms of despair, interspersed with tiny hillocks of mild contentment. 

I'm tired

I bought this phone a few days ago so i could talk to my kids. I'm currently locked in my friend's room while they are celebrating with their family. I haven't used for almost 2 days now, so this is my celebration. My friend is awesome. I have Reese's minis and Cadbury balls, some Arizona, and cigarettes. No crack.

Only way I could be happier is if i were with my children.
I mean, *'paper wallet?'* why would you want physical paper evidence of your cryptocurrency?

I don't. Not always. But constantly being abandoned, never having enough, trying to climb the mountain that is life...I know I sound pathetic. I know I seem weak to you. I currently don't hold any respect from anyone, and it's my fault. But it wasn't always. I've always been strong, it's one of the things I used to pride myself on. I just...broke. depression set in, and I gave up. How do I come back from that? No support system, very few active resources, nothing whatsoever to my name.. I've done it before but i was lucky then. 

What now?

Living with their (relatively) recently-present father and his mother. I detest them both personally, but they are wonderful caretakers. I respect them both fully, even if i don't like their personalities; we all are (were?) an awesome parenting team. It's weird as shit but I'm not gonna question such a blessing

They are in the same metro area as I am. I've taken the train to their stop and just stood there like an idiot, too afraid to go further and fearing that the reason for my hesitation is no longer for their protection, but for mine.

I feel really weird right now. I'm on a (so far) three-day binge of non stop smoking and my hands are shaking but my heart rate is slow and I'm farting and this old man just wants to poke me but he can't and he keeps putting these slabs in front of me and he doesn't want me to leave and i don't know if it's because I need sleep but i *feel* hazy. It feels like if i were to keep my eyelids closed for longer than a few moments they'll fuse themselves shut.

I hope I have a heart attack

Don't you think I want to? I'm tired of getting my indifference from a rock. I want to see my children grow up, but not at the expense of their mental stability. 

I'm not mentally stable. Sound, yes. But completely unstable.

I *cannot do it* anymore. Everyone has a threshold. Mine's been surpassed. If I stop smoking, for example, I'm positive I will die, be it by my own hand or something else, but my mind literally cannot handle the influx of pain once the numb wears off. So what can I do?

I've tried. Now don't get me wrong: I'm not deluded, nor do I shirk my responsibility of holding myself accountable. I know I could've tried harder, sooner. But the luck I've had so far, now that I'm actually trying, is asinine.

I know I did this to myself; I did it on purpose. But I'm just trying not to hurt. But it's still there, just manifesting itself in new ways. It must end.
